why: These tests start the real Codex binary (node_modules/.bin/codex or the bundled @openai/codex). The local gate does not install it: it runs with CODEX_ACP_SKIP_BINARY_TESTS=1 (local patch test-skip-binary) and requires exactly these tests, plus expectedUpstreamSkips, to be skipped. The planned real-combination suite (real Codex CLI + built artifact) takes them over.

src/__tests__/CodexACPAgent/CodexAcpClie: should authenticate with CODEX_API_KEY from the environment
should fall back to OPENAI_API_KEY from the environment
should report a clear error when the selected API key env var is missing
should show account in /status for api key auth and hide it for gateway auth
handles builtin slash command locally when prompt has attachments
should fallback to the default model when modelId is null
should fallback to the model-specific effort when reasoningEffort is null
should keep a model id that is not in the advertised catalog (custom provider)
should default the effort for an uncatalogued model when reasoningEffort is null
src/__tests__/CodexACPAgent/mcp-config-m: should preserve the global url-based MCP when ACP passes a command-type MCP with the same name
should preserve a project url-based MCP when ACP passes a command-type MCP with the same name
should not filter the conflicting ACP MCP when config filtering is disabled
